featured_reviews.review_text: I had undergone a total knee replacement in 2018 which was unsuccessful. The doctor was non-committal and waved off our query as - this is a common phenomenon and it generally rights itself, carefully avoiding to tell us what it was. We came to know later on, that it was a dislocated patella. Cutting to 2025 we were extremely fortunate to have heard about Dr. Ahmed from a friend of ours, whose 80+ yr old, bed ridden mother had been treated by him and now, not only does she walk around but can use the staircase as well. We lost no time getting in touch with him and after having come to see me to get an idea as to what  the problem was, he agreed to take me on. Within a month of our engaging with him, he has managed to manually relocate my patella back into its groove. I must mention here that we had consulted a couple of orthopedic surgeons in the interim and they all gave us no other option except to go in for corrective surgery, which we refused. Dr Ahmed is a very pleasant, compassionate and an empathetic gentleman who considers his passion as a God given gift to him. We have since come across many of his success stories from people in our neighbourhood. I would, without hesitation, urge anyone who is reading this and is dealing with an orthopedic problem, to see him asap.
